title: Confidence Calibration of Deep Learning Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.12100v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In high-stakes applications, reliable confidence estimates are as important as the predictions themselves. Confidence calibration ensures that predicted probabilities reflect the likelihood of correctness, making it essential for safe deployment of deep learning models. However, existing methods typically assume access to clean validation data, which is often unrealistic due to label noise and domain shifts. This thesis develops methods for improving calibration under these conditions.   First, we address calibration under label noise. Standard methods can produce misleading confidence estimates when labels are unreliable. We propose a framework that uses an estimated noise model to reconstruct noise-free confidence estimates by modeling the relationship between noisy and clean label distributions. translated_title: 深度学习系统的置信度校准
translated_abstract: 在高风险应用中，可靠的置信度估计与预测本身同样重要。置信度校准确保预测概率反映正确性的可能性，这对于深度学习模型的安全部署至关重要。然而，现有方法通常假设可以访问干净的验证数据，但由于标签噪声和领域偏移，这一假设往往不现实。本论文开发了在这些条件下改进校准的方法。首先，我们解决了标签噪声下的校准问题。当标签不可靠时，标准方法可能产生误导性的置信度估计。我们提出一个框架，利用估计的噪声模型，通过建模噪声标签分布与干净标签分布之间的关系，重建无噪声的置信度估计。我们将此方法扩展到保形预测（CP），该方法提供具有保证覆盖率的集合值预测。我们的噪声感知CP方法...
tldr: 本论文提出在标签噪声和领域偏移条件下，通过噪声模型重建无噪声置信度估计，并扩展至保形预测，从而改进深度学习模型的校准可靠性。
en_tdlr: This thesis improves deep learning calibration under label noise and domain shifts by reconstructing noise-free confidence estimates via an estimated noise model and extending it to conformal prediction.
